scope: Pre-training research-integrity phase (no detector training performed)
experimental_validation_statement: CSA-YOLO is NOT experimentally validated. Modules are implemented and unit tested. No detector has been trained and no research metric has been measured.

test_status.note: No xfail remains. Every defect that had an xfail now has a passing regression test.

dataset_leakage_status.status: EXACT-IMAGE LEAKAGE RESOLVED; near-duplicates NOT YET MEASURED
dataset_leakage_status.image_label_pairing: verified: 0 images without labels, 0 labels without images
dataset_leakage_status.hash_algorithm: SHA-256 (the earlier audit used MD5; SHA-256 is used for this check)

defects_from_audit.fix: Spatial gate around body regions; margin in configs/default.yaml (association.gate_margin_ratio, PROVISIONAL)

defects_from_audit.issue: One PPE item could belong to multiple workers
defects_from_audit.fix: One-to-one assignment per class with the Hungarian algorithm

defects_from_audit.issue: Hungarian algorithm imported but not executed
defects_from_audit.fix: Executed in match_one_to_one; verified against exhaustive search on 20 seeded cases

defects_from_audit.issue: Helmet never detected was treated as UNKNOWN rather than as evidence; single-frame decisions were possible
defects_from_audit.fix: Three-state rule: a class is ABSENT or PRESENT only with min_evidence_frames observations and threshold ratios; TSMM records absence for each required class each frame

defects_from_audit.issue: remove_old_tracks compared global frame index with per-worker active count; never called
defects_from_audit.fix: States record last_seen_frame; cleanup runs every frame with max_age from configuration

defects_from_audit.issue: Site summary counted every scored worker as non-compliant
defects_from_audit.fix: Counts come from compliance results; compliant + non_compliant + unknown == total_workers; zero-worker case defined

additional_defects_found_and_fixed.issue: CRAM double-counted a missing PPE item: its 0.0 confidence also triggered the low-confidence penalty
Tracker was not updated on frames with no workers, so stale tracks could be re-matched after long gaps
Documentation claimed WPAM used IoU and exclusive assignment and that the README claimed unimplemented features; several results were presented as facts

remaining_known_limitations: WPAM gate margin (0.10) is PROVISIONAL and not tuned
Occlusion of PPE is indistinguishable from absence
IoU tracker identity breaks under fast motion or occlusion longer than max_age
CRAM weights are hand-set and not validated
Near-duplicate images are not detected by exact hashing (NOT YET MEASURED)
Label agreement between dropped duplicate copies was not checked
